title: KKKKhazix/AIHOT
why_read: A framework for building your own personalized 'trending topics' aggregator/newsletter site, useful mainly as a template rather than offering novel technical ideas.
analysis: AIHOT is a TypeScript framework that lets you build your own site which automatically finds trending topics and generates a daily digest, letting you plug in your own sources and curation criteria. It's essentially a customizable aggregation and summarization pipeline, likely LLM-powered given the 'self-writing daily report' framing, aimed at people who want their own niche trend-tracking site. The high star count suggests strong adoption in Chinese-language developer communities, but the core idea is more of a practical utility than a deep technical innovation.
